items.translation: 已构建一个ConditionMessage。

items.source: Indicate that one or more results were found.
items.translation: 指示已找到一个或多个结果。

items.source: article - the article found
items.translation: article - 找到的文章

items.source: singular - the article found in singular form
items.translation: singular - 以单数形式出现的文章

items.source: plural - the article found in plural form
items.translation: plural - 复数形式的文章

items.source: Builder used to create a ConditionMessage for a condition.
items.translation: 用于为条件创建 ConditionMessage` 的 Builder。

items.source: Indicate that an exact result was found. For example foundExactly("foo") results in the message "found foo".
items.translation: 指示已找到确切结果。例如，`foundExactly("foo")` 生成的消息为 "found foo"。

items.source: Indicate that one or more results were found. For example found("bean").items("x") results in the message "found bean x".
items.translation: 指示已找到一个或多个结果。例如，`found("bean").items("x")` 会导致消息 "found bean x"。

items.source: Indicate that one or more results were found. For example found("bean", "beans").items("x", "y") results in the message "found beans x, y".
items.translation: 指示已找到一个或多个结果。例如，`found("bean", "beans").items("x", "y")` 会导致消息 "found beans x, y"。

items.source: Indicate that one or more results were not found. For example didNotFind("bean").items("x") results in the message "did not find bean x".
items.translation: 指示未找到一个或多个结果。例如，`didNotFind("bean").items("x")` 生成的消息为 "did not find bean x"。

items.source: Indicate that one or more results were found. For example didNotFind("bean", "beans").items("x", "y") results in the message "did not find beans x, y".
items.translation: 指示已找到一个或多个结果。例如，`didNotFind("bean", "beans").items("x", "y")` 生成的消息为“未找到 beans x, y"。

items.source: Indicates a single result. For example resultedIn("yes") results in the message "resulted in yes".
items.translation: 表示单个结果。例如，resultedIn("yes") 的结果是消息 "resulted in yes"。

items.source: Indicates something is available. For example available("money") results in the message "money is available".
items.translation: 表示某物可用。例如，available("money") 的结果是消息 "money is available"。

items.source: Indicates something is not available. For example notAvailable("time") results in the message "time is not available".
items.translation: 表示某项不可用。例如，notAvailable("time") 会生成消息 "time is not available"。

items.source: Indicates the reason. For example because("running Linux") results in the message "running Linux".
items.translation: 指示原因。例如，because("running Linux") 会导致消息为"running Linux"。
